record_title: Exact Hessian spectrum of the uncentered Gaussian volume product at the ball
limitations: This is a local second-variation result. It does not settle the higher-dimensional global maximization gap, determine nonlinear behavior of the degree-one kernel at the exact threshold, or assert a uniform neighborhood stability theorem. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with residual risk from unindexed concurrent work because the motivating preprint is extremely recent.
